summary: Learn to test AI outputs, monitor bias and drift, and document evidence. Explore practical AI output assurance training for your team.
lede: AI output assurance checks production AI systems against defined quality, safety and fairness criteria. For AI product owners, auditors, data scientists and risk teams, the training provides a practical way to test outputs and preserve evidence for review. Participants learn to design evaluation datasets and scorecards, assess bias and drift, and set human-review and escalation workflows while documenting incidents and decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who test, govern, review or report on AI systems in production. It suits people who need operational assurance controls rather than general AI awareness or prompt-writing instruction.
prerequisites: Recommended preparation: basic familiarity with AI-enabled products or data-driven business processes. Coding is not required; exercises focus on test design, spreadsheet tracking, review workflows and assurance documentation. Advanced AI evaluation and fairness concepts receive operational or conceptual coverage, not technical engineering or production deployment instruction.
